DEALINGS IN SECURITIES BY THE COMPANY'S 2021 SHARE PLAN

In compliance with paragraph 6.90 of the Listings Requirements of the JSE Limited (“the JSE Listings Requirements”), shareholders are advised of the following transaction. The transaction relates to the on-market sale of forfeited shares by the Company’s 2021 Share Plan. The sale was undertaken in accordance with the rules of the Share Plan.
